Synopsis:
Ukraine's sanctions commissioner is lobbying the U.S. House to pass the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026," which cleared the Senate 86-11. The bill would sanction Russian officials and authorize up to 100% tariffs on major Russian energy consumers (China, India, EU, Japan). Despite Trump's support, passage is uncertain: Democrats — led by Jeffries — are wary of handing Trump broad tariff authority ahead of November midterms, and some Republicans oppose tariffs on free-market grounds. No House vote is yet scheduled.
